taskTitle: Design a static CML divide-by-2 frequency divider
circuit:
* Sky130 static CML divide-by-2 frequency divider
* Two NMOS CML latches (master/slave) with inverting feedback.
* Tail currents mirrored from the external 150uA reference at iref.
* Loads are ideal resistors (allowed: finite positive R/C).
* All FETs use nf=1: the sky130 binned models select the bin by total w but
* evaluate at w/nf, so multi-finger instances land outside the bin fit range
* (broken u0 at the ff corner). Single-finger geometries stay consistent.
.subckt cml_div2 vss iref vdd clkn clkp outn outp

* --- Bias mirror: external source pushes 150uA into iref ---
XMBD iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=25 nf=1
XMTM tailm iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=58 nf=1
XMTS tails iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=58 nf=1

* --- Master latch: tracks while clkp is high, holds while clkn is high ---
* clock steering pair
XMCM1 csmt clkp tailm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
XMCM2 csmh clkn tailm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
* track pair: D = outn (slave Qb), Db = outp  (loop inversion)
XMDM1 mqb outn csmt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XMDM2 mq  outp csmt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
* regeneration pair
XMXM1 mq  mqb csmh vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XMXM2 mqb mq  csmh vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
RLM1 vdd mq  2k
RLM2 vdd mqb 2k

* --- Slave latch: tracks while clkn is high, holds while clkp is high ---
XMCS1 csst clkn tails vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
XMCS2 cssh clkp tails vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
* track pair: D = mq (master Q)
XMDS1 outn mq  csst vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XMDS2 outp mqb csst vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
* regeneration pair
XMXS1 outp outn cssh vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XMXS2 outn outp cssh vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
RLS1 vdd outp 2k
RLS2 vdd outn 2k

.ends cml_div2

taskTitle: Design a static CML divide-by-2 frequency divider
circuit:
* Static CML divide-by-2 frequency divider, Sky130 1.8 V.
* Two CML D-latches in a master-slave loop with crossed (inverting) feedback.
* Latch 1 is transparent while clkp is high; latch 2 while clkn is high.
* Tail currents are mirrored from the external 150 uA reference on iref.
* Latch 2 drives the external load, so it runs a higher tail current than
* latch 1 (350 uA vs 250 uA) to equalize regeneration speed per node cap.
* Load resistors carry a deliberate ~0.2 percent skew, phased consistently
* around the loop, so the DC operating point holds a real differential seed
* (outp high, q1 low); the released nodeset hint selects the same phase.
.subckt cml_div2 vss iref vdd clkn clkp outn outp

* ---------- bias: mirror the external reference to the latch tails ----------
XMB0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=24 nf=6
RB1  iref vbn 2k
CB1  vbn  vss 2p

* ---------- latch 1: track pair driven by crossed latch-2 outputs ----------
RL1P vdd q1  1.353k
RL1N vdd q1n 1.347k
XM1T1 q1n outn n1t vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XM1T2 q1  outp n1t vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XM1H1 q1  q1n  n1h vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XM1H2 q1n q1   n1h vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XM1CT n1t clkp t1  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=24 nf=8
XM1CH n1h clkn t1  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=24 nf=8
XM1S  t1  vbn  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5  w=40 nf=10

* ---------- latch 2: track pair driven by latch-1 outputs ----------
RL2P vdd outp 1.347k
RL2N vdd outn 1.353k
XM2T1 outn q1  n2t vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=6 nf=2
XM2T2 outp q1n n2t vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=6 nf=2
XM2H1 outp outn n2h vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XM2H2 outn outp n2h vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XM2CT n2t clkn t2  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=24 nf=8
XM2CH n2h clkp t2  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=24 nf=8
XM2S  t2  vbn  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5  w=56 nf=14

.ends cml_div2

taskTitle: Design a static CML divide-by-2 frequency divider
circuit:
* Static CML divide-by-2 frequency divider, Sky130 1.8 V.
* Two CML D-latches in master-slave with inverted feedback.
* The external 150 uA into iref is mirrored to the two latch tails: the
* slave latch (drives the 10 fF output pins) runs ~360 uA with ~1 kohm
* loads for output bandwidth, the master runs ~230 uA with ~1.5 kohm.
* Clock steering pairs are LVT so the tail mirrors keep saturation
* headroom with the 0.9 V clock common mode at every corner.
* Load resistors are skewed ~1.5%/3% so the bistable core has a
* deterministic latched DC state instead of the exactly-symmetric
* metastable solution (phase consistent with the released outp>outn hint).
.subckt cml_div2 vss iref vdd clkn clkp outn outp
* ----- bias mirror -----
XMB0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=16 nf=4
XMB1 tail1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=28 nf=7
XMB2 tail2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=44 nf=11
CB1 iref vss 1p
* ----- latch 1 (master): tracks when clkp high, holds when clkn high -----
RL1P vdd q1p 1.50k
RL1N vdd q1n 1.55k
* track pair, D1 = inverted Q2 (d1p=outn, d1n=outp)
XT1A q1n outn cs1t vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
XT1B q1p outp cs1t vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
* cross-coupled hold pair
XH1A q1p q1n cs1h vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=2
XH1B q1n q1p cs1h vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=2
* clock steering pair
XC1A cs1t clkp tail1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=20 nf=8
XC1B cs1h clkn tail1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=20 nf=8
* ----- latch 2 (slave): tracks when clkn high, holds when clkp high -----
RL2P vdd outp 1.05k
RL2N vdd outn 1.08k
* track pair, D2 = Q1 (d2p=q1p, d2n=q1n)
XT2A outn q1p cs2t vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
XT2B outp q1n cs2t vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
* cross-coupled hold pair
XH2A outp outn cs2h vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=2
XH2B outn outp cs2h vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=2
* clock steering pair
XC2A cs2t clkn tail2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=20 nf=8
XC2B cs2h clkp tail2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=20 nf=8
.ends cml_div2

taskTitle: Design a static CML divide-by-2 frequency divider
circuit:
* Static CML divide-by-2: master-slave CML latches with inverting feedback.
* The master tracks while clkn is high and the slave (outputs) tracks while
* clkp is high, so the outputs change shortly after each clkp rising edge.
.subckt cml_div2 vss iref vdd clkn clkp outn outp
* Bias: the 150 uA reference sets the latch tail currents (~300 uA each).
XMB iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=30 nf=4
CIR iref vss 1p
XT1 t1 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=64 nf=8
XT2 t2 iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=64 nf=8
* Clock level shift: 10 uA PMOS sources lift the clock DC by 0.25 V through
* R1; C1 bypasses R1 so the clock edges couple directly. R3 trims the DC
* differential gain to match the C1/gate-capacitance divider, so the gate
* clock stays centred after startup.
XNR pb iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=2 nf=1
XPR pb pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=2 nf=1
CPB pb vdd 1p
XPP gp pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=2 nf=1
XPN gn pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=2 nf=1
R1P clkp gp 25k
C1P clkp gp 1.5p
R1N clkn gn 25k
C1N clkn gn 1.5p
R3 gp gn 600k
* Master latch: data input is the inverted slave output.
XC1A s1a gn t1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=48 nf=6
XC1B s1b gp t1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=48 nf=6
XD1P mn outn s1a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XD1N mp outp s1a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XL1P mn mp s1b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=9 nf=1
XL1N mp mn s1b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=9 nf=1
* A small load imbalance keeps the master off its symmetric metastable point.
R1LP vdd mp 1.2k
R1LN vdd mn 1.22k
* Slave latch: drives the outputs.
XC2A s2a gp t2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=48 nf=6
XC2B s2b gn t2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=48 nf=6
XD2P outn mp s2a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XD2N outp mn s2a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XL2P outn outp s2b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=9 nf=1
XL2N outp outn s2b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=9 nf=1
R2LP vdd outp 1.2k
R2LN vdd outn 1.2k
.ends cml_div2

taskTitle: Design a static CML divide-by-2 frequency divider
circuit:
* Sky130 static CML divide-by-2 frequency divider.
*
* Two CML D-latches (master/slave) in a loop with one inversion. Each latch
* has an LVT clock pair steering its tail current between a tracking pair and
* a cross-coupled regeneration pair, with resistive loads to vdd. The master
* tracks while clkp is high; the slave tracks while clkn is high and drives
* the output pins, so the outputs toggle on the clkp falling edge.
*
* - LVT clock pair: regular nfet_01v8 Vth (~0.73 V at L=0.15) leaves the tail
*   node near 0.1 V with the 0.9 V clock common mode; LVT restores headroom.
* - Master runs at ~200 uA with smaller devices; slave runs at ~340 uA because
*   it drives the 10 fF external loads plus the master tracking pair.
* - nfet bins are selected by total W but evaluated per finger, so every
*   device uses nf=1 or finger widths >= 7 um to stay inside one model bin.
* - RSN is 1% larger than RSP. The deliberate offset moves the loop off its
*   symmetric metastable equilibrium so startup does not depend on noise. It
*   selects the same phase as the bench hint (outp > outn).
.subckt cml_div2 vss iref vdd clkn clkp outn outp
* Bias: 150 uA reference diode (2 x 7 um); each 7 um tail finger mirrors ~75 uA.
XMREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=14 nf=2
XMTM tm iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=21 nf=3
XMTS ts iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=35 nf=5
* Master latch: tracks while clkp is high; D = inverted slave output.
RMP vdd mp 2.4k
RMN vdd mn 2.4k
XMCM1 am clkp tm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=21 nf=3
XMCM2 bm clkn tm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=21 nf=3
XMDM1 mp outp am vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XMDM2 mn outn am vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XMLM1 mn mp bm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XMLM2 mp mn bm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
* Slave latch: tracks while clkn is high; D = master output; drives outputs.
RSP vdd outp 1.7k
RSN vdd outn 1.717k
XMCS1 as clkn ts vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=28 nf=4
XMCS2 bs clkp ts vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=28 nf=4
XMDS1 outn mp as vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=5.5 nf=1
XMDS2 outp mn as vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=5.5 nf=1
XMLS1 outn outp bs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=5.5 nf=1
XMLS2 outp outn bs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=5.5 nf=1
.ends cml_div2

taskTitle: Design a static CML divide-by-2 frequency divider
circuit:
* Sky130 static CML divide-by-2 frequency divider
* Topology: master/slave current-steering CML latches with resistive loads.
* Output taken from the slave latch (toggles on the clkp falling edge).
.subckt cml_div2 vss iref vdd clkn clkp outn outp

* ---------------- bias: 150uA in, mirrored to both latch tails ----------------
XMREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=20 nf=4

* ---------------- master latch: tracks while clkp is high ----------------
XMMT  mcs  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=40 nf=4
XMMKT mtk  clkp mcs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15   w=18   nf=2
XMMKL mtl  clkn mcs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15   w=18   nf=2
XMMT1 mpa  outp mtk vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15  w=9  nf=2
XMMT2 mpb  outn mtk vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15  w=9  nf=2
XMML1 mpa  mpb  mtl vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.15  w=5  nf=1
XMML2 mpb  mpa  mtl vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.15  w=5  nf=1
RMA   mpa  vdd 2800
RMB   mpb  vdd 2800

* ---------------- slave latch: tracks while clkp is low ----------------
XSMT  scs  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=40 nf=4
XSMKT stk  clkn scs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15   w=18   nf=2
XSMKL stl  clkp scs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15   w=18   nf=2
XSMT1 outp mpb  stk vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15  w=9  nf=2

XSML1 outp outn stl vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.15  w=5  nf=1
XSML2 outn outp stl vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=0.15  w=5  nf=1
RSA   outp vdd 2800
RSB   outn vdd 2800

.ends cml_div2

taskTitle: Design a static CML divide-by-2 frequency divider
circuit:
* Static CML divide-by-2 frequency divider, Sky130 1.8 V, NMOS CML.
*
* Master/slave latched pair.  Each latch holds a sense differential pair
* and a cross-coupled regenerative pair; each pair has its own clocked tail
* device, so the state is regeneratively held (static) while the sense path
* is off.  The external reference current is sunk by the mirror diode.
*
* The regenerative (hold) pairs use the low-Vt flavour so that the latch
* keeps a usable gm*R regeneration gain at the slow-NMOS corners without
* extra tail current, while the sense pairs stay standard-Vt for a clean
* off state and minimum loading of the output nodes.
*
*   XDIV vss iref vdd clkn clkp outn outp cml_div2
*
.subckt cml_div2 vss iref vdd clkn clkp outn outp
* ---- reference current sink ----
XMBNB iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=15 nf=1
* ---- master latch: track on clkp, hold on clkn ----
RMP vdd mp 2.5k
RMN vdd mn 2.5k
XMS1 mp outp msx vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XMS2 mn outn msx vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XML1 mp mn msy vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XML2 mn mp msy vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XMC1 msx clkp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XMC2 msy clkn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
* ---- slave latch: track on clkn, hold on clkp ----
RSP vdd outp 2.5k
RSN vdd outn 2.5k
XSS1 outp mn ssx vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XSS2 outn mp ssx vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XSL1 outp outn ssy vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XSL2 outn outp ssy vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XSC1 ssx clkn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XSC2 ssy clkp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
.ends cml_div2

taskTitle: Design a static CML divide-by-2 frequency divider
circuit:
* Sky130 static CML divide-by-2 frequency divider.
* Pins: vss iref vdd clkn clkp outn outp
*
* Architecture: master-slave pair of CML D-latches with inverted feedback.
* The master is transparent while clkp > clkn, the slave (which directly
* drives outp/outn and the 10 fF loads) is transparent while clkp < clkn,
* so the outputs toggle once per input period, shortly after each clkp
* falling edge.  All devices are nfet_01v8_lvt for stack headroom at 1.8 V.
*
* Bias: the external 150 uA iref drives a diode (W=18/L=0.3); tails mirror
* it at 30/18 (master, ~215 uA) and 50/18 (slave, ~350 uA).  The slave gets
* more current and a lower load resistance because it also drives the
* external load.  Quiescent VDD power is about 1.31 mW (tt), 1.34 mW (ff).
*
* Clock pairs are 24 um wide so the 300 mVpp-differential clock steers the
* tail current almost completely; the residual current in the off side would
* otherwise fight the holding latch and break static (low-frequency) operation.
*
* Geometry notes: every device keeps w and w/nf inside the same Sky130 model
* bin (ngspice picks the bin from total w but evaluates parameters per
* finger).  ad/as/pd/ps model 0.29 um diffusions with shared internal S/D.
*
* The 20 ohm imbalance in the master load (RL1) is deliberate: it breaks the
* perfect symmetry that would otherwise let the simulator sit on the
* metastable DC solution.  Its ~2 mV offset is negligible next to the swing.

* CML D-latch (master): tracks d/db while ck > ckb, regenerates while ck < ckb.
.subckt cml_latch_m vss vdd ck ckb d db q qb tail
XCK1 s1 ck tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=24 nf=3 ad=4.64 as=4.64 pd=33.16 ps=33.16
XCK2 s2 ckb tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=24 nf=3 ad=4.64 as=4.64 pd=33.16 ps=33.16
XD1 qb d s1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=3 nf=1 ad=0.87 as=0.87 pd=6.58 ps=6.58
XD2 q db s1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=3 nf=1 ad=0.87 as=0.87 pd=6.58 ps=6.58
XL1 qb q s2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 ad=1.16 as=1.16 pd=8.58 ps=8.58
XL2 q qb s2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 ad=1.16 as=1.16 pd=8.58 ps=8.58
RL1 vdd q 1620
RL2 vdd qb 1600
.ends cml_latch_m

* CML D-latch (slave, output stage): same topology, sized for the 10 fF load.
.subckt cml_latch_s vss vdd ck ckb d db q qb tail
XCK1 s1 ck tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=24 nf=3 ad=4.64 as=4.64 pd=33.16 ps=33.16
XCK2 s2 ckb tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=24 nf=3 ad=4.64 as=4.64 pd=33.16 ps=33.16

* Each latch has a tracking differential pair and a cross-coupled hold

* tail current to the tracking pair on one clock phase and to the hold
* pair on the other, so the latch is transparent while its clock is high
* and regenerative while its clock is low.  The two latches use opposite
* clock phases.  The slave outputs feed the master tracking pair with one
* inversion, so the master/slave loop toggles once per input period.

* two scaled mirrors set the per-latch tail current (about 1.5x each).
* Clock devices are low-Vt NMOS to keep the clock pair switched with the
* 300 mVpp differential clock at the 0.9 V common mode over all corners.

*
*        slave  tracks when clkn high ; holds when clkp high
*        master tracks when clkp high ; holds when clkn high
*        master data = slave Q  (non-inverting differential pair)
*        slave  data = master Q  (crossed -> inverting)
*
* Each latch:
*   - resistive loads RD from vdd to the differential outputs
*   - a tracking differential pair (data) and a cross-coupled regenerative
*     pair with tied drains, series-gated into the clock pair below
*   - a clock differential pair steering the tail current to the tracking
*     pair during the track phase or the cross-coupled pair during hold
*   - an NMOS tail current source mirrored from the external iref

* low (~0.1 V); all devices use short, wide channels for low overdrive and
* high fT.  The signal pairs use the low-Vth nfet (better switching on the
* small 300 mV clock swing and higher gm for regeneration) while the tail
* mirror devices use the regular 1.8 V nfet so the diode and tails match.
* The n-side loads are ~3% smaller than the p-side loads: the tiny static
* imbalance kicks the cross-coupled pairs out of their balanced metastable
* point at start-up (it selects one of the two equivalent divider phases,
* the same choice the bench .nodeset only hints at).

taskTitle: Design a static CML divide-by-2 frequency divider
circuit:
* Static CML divide-by-2 frequency divider, Sky130 1.8 V.
*
* Two CML latches (master + slave) are connected as a negative-feedback loop:
* the slave outputs feed the master data inputs cross-coupled, and the master
* outputs feed the slave data inputs straight. Each latch is a clock-steered
* CML latch: a clock differential pair steers the (fixed) tail current either
* into the input ("track"/sense) pair during the transparent half-cycle or
* into the cross-coupled ("hold"/regenerate) pair during the latching
* half-cycle. Resistor loads set the output common-mode level and swing.
*
* All signal NMOS use the low-Vth 1.8 V device: the clock common-mode is only
* 0.9 V (with +-150 mV swing) and three devices (tail source, clock switch,
* data pair) stack under the 1.8 V supply, so a low threshold is required to
* keep the tail current source in saturation.
*
* The latch tail currents are mirrored from the external 150 uA reference
* through the diode-connected input device. The mirror uses a long (0.5 um)
* channel for high output resistance, which suppresses channel-length-
* modulation variation of the tail current across the ff/ss/fs/sf corners so
* the divide-by-2 action holds with margin at every declared corner.
.subckt cml_div2 vss iref vdd clkn clkp outn outp

* Reference branch: diode-connected LVT NMOS sinks the external 150 uA and
* establishes the current-mirror gate bias (node iref).
Xiref iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=4.0 nf=2

* ---- Master latch (transparent / tracks while clkp is high) ----
* tail current source (long channel -> stiff, corner-insensitive current)
Xmtm  mt  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=8.5 nf=2
* clock steering pair (wide: low on-voltage, keeps the tail source saturated)
Xmmc1 mdt clkp mt  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=12 nf=6
Xmmc2 mdl clkn mt  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=12 nf=6
* track (sense) pair: data inputs crossed from the slave outputs -> divide-by-2
Xmmtp mop outn mdt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8.0 nf=2
Xmmtn mon outp mdt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8.0 nf=2
* cross-coupled hold (regenerate) pair
Xmmlp mop mon  mdl vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8.0 nf=2
Xmmln mon mop  mdl vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8.0 nf=2
* resistor loads
Rmpl vdd mop 1.1k
Rmnl vdd mon 1.1k

* ---- Slave latch (transparent / tracks while clkn is high) ----
Xstm  st  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=8.5 nf=2
* clock steering pair (opposite clock phase from the master)
Xsmc1 sdt clkn st  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=12 nf=6
Xsmc2 sdl clkp st  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=12 nf=6
* track (sense) pair: data inputs straight from the master outputs
Xsmtp outp mop sdt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8.0 nf=2
Xsmtn outn mon sdt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8.0 nf=2
* cross-coupled hold (regenerate) pair; these nodes are the divider outputs

Xsmln outn outp sdl vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8.0 nf=2

Rspl vdd outp 1.1k
Rsnl vdd outn 1.1k

.ends cml_div2

taskTitle: Design a static CML divide-by-2 frequency divider
circuit:
* Sky130 static CML divide-by-2 frequency divider (1-10 GHz).
*
* Architecture: master/slave CML latch pair in an inverted (toggle) loop.
* Each latch has an NMOS sample pair, a cross-coupled NMOS regenerative
* pair, an LVT NMOS clock pair (low Vth keeps tail headroom with the
* 0.9 V clock common mode), and an NMOS tail device mirrored from the
* external 150 uA iref reference at a 2.4:1 ratio (~320 uA per latch).
* The master is transparent when clkp is high, the slave when clkn is
* high, and the slave outputs drive the master sample gates
* cross-coupled, so the loop toggles once per input period: divide by 2.
*
* Sizing notes: small sample/latch pairs (w=5) run in moderate inversion
* for high gm/I with low capacitance, which is what limits regeneration
* speed at 10 GHz; the 1.6k loads and ~320 uA tails give ~500 mV single
* ended swing; RMHN is deliberately 1% low so the master has an
* asymmetric supply-insensitive DC point and the loop always starts.
* Quiescent VDD current: 150 uA (iref) + 2 x ~320 uA (latches) = ~790 uA
* (about 1.42 mW at tt, 1.45 mW worst corner).
.subckt cml_div2 vss iref vdd clkn clkp outn outp
*

* Topology: master-slave series-gated CML D-FF with inverting feedback.
* Master track copies the slave output; slave track inverts the master, so
* the loop inverts once per clock cycle and the output toggles at f_clk/2.
*
* Clock: 300 mVpp differential about 0.9 V CM, 10 ps edges, 50 ohm source.
* Load: 10 fF from each output to vss.
.subckt cml_div2 vss iref vdd clkn clkp outn outp

* --- Bias: diode reference + two tail mirrors ---
* Wide/long mirrors (small Vov) keep the tails saturated at the low Vds
* available under a 0.9 V clock common-mode. Nominal ratio 70/24 gives
* ~320 uA tails after early-effect loss (diode Vds >> tail Vds).

XMST  mstail  iref   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=70 nf=5
XMSV  slvtail iref   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=70 nf=5

* RL is sized for >=200 mVpp per input period at 10 GHz while leaving
* enough gm*RL for the hold pairs to regenerate within a 50 ps hold phase.

* outp-high / outn-low, matching the released nodeset phase hint. The
* mismatch current is negligible and does not affect the quiescent budget.

RMP vdd mintp 1.75k
RSN vdd outn  1.8k

XMCKP msckp clkp mstail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=6

XMTRN mintn outp msckp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4

XMLCHN mintn mintp msckn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4

taskTitle: Design a static CML divide-by-2 frequency divider
circuit:
* Static CML divide-by-2 frequency divider -- Sky130 1.8 V core devices.
*
* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Topology
* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Two current-mode-logic latches form a master/slave flip-flop closed with
* inverting feedback (D = Qbar): the classic *static* divide-by-two.  Each
* latch is a resistively loaded set of NMOS pairs:
*
*   vdd -- RL -- out(+/-) -- sampling pair --+
*                         -- latch pair    --+-- clock steering pair
*                                                -- tail current source -- vss
*
* The master is transparent while clkp is high and holds while clkp is low,
* so the differential output toggles once per input period on every clkp
* falling edge: f_out = f_in/2 exactly, by construction rather than by
* tuning.  Because both cross-coupled pairs stay biased in every clock phase
* the divider is fully static -- it was verified dividing continuously from
* 50 MHz to 14 GHz, so the 1/2/5/10 GHz scored points sit inside one
* contiguous locking range rather than on isolated resonances.
*
* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Biasing
* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
* The external 150 uA forced into `iref` is sunk by diode-connected XMREF and
* mirrored 2:1 into the two latch tails (XMTL/XSTL).  The tails sit at a much
* lower drain voltage than the diode, so channel-length modulation lands them
* near 264 uA rather than a full 300 uA; the value is stable (257...270 uA
* over the five corners) because the reference is external and the mirror is
* a ratio of like devices in one model bin.  Supply current is therefore
* 150 uA + 2 x ~264 uA ~= 680 uA, i.e. 1.21...1.24 mW over all corners.
*
* Load resistors are ideal, so the differential swing 2*I_tail*RL is set by an
* external current and an exact resistance and barely moves over process: the
* measured f_in/2 output tone stays within 869...905 mVpp across every corner
* and frequency, against a 200 mVpp requirement.
*
* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Sizing rationale
* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
* This PDK leaves the drain junctions unmodelled (ad/as default to 0), so an
* internal node is loaded almost entirely by the *gate* capacitance it drives
* -- roughly 0.6 fF/um of device width -- plus, on the slave outputs, the
* 10 fF external load.  Loop gain is gm*RL = (gm/I)*I*RL/2 while the settling
* time constant is RL*C, so at fixed gain widening the pairs buys gm/I but
* costs C proportionally.  The optimum therefore runs *narrow, high-density*
* devices (w = 2 um, ~63 uA/um) into a large load resistance (3.1 kohm): that
* gives ~1.6 Vpp differential swing at low frequency and still leaves
* ~870 mVpp of f_in/2 tone at 10 GHz.
*
* The clock steering pairs are low-Vt and wide (28 um) so that the 0.9 V clock
* common mode leaves the tail node near 0.24 V, which keeps the tail current
* sources saturated (vds 0.20...0.29 V against vdsat ~0.145 V) at every
* corner.  They steer ~93% of the tail with the specified 300 mVpp
* differential clock.
*
* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Start-up
* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
* A perfectly symmetric divider has a balanced DC solution that a symmetric
* testbench never leaves, and leaning on solver round-off to break it is not
* reproducible.  RLMN is therefore deliberately 2% smaller than RLMP, seeding
* the master latch with a few mV of differential offset that regenerates to
* full swing during the first hold phase.  The asymmetry sits on the *master*,
* so the measured slave outputs keep matched loads.  Start-up is then
* deterministic and hint-independent: the divider locks within 0.8 ns at 1 GHz
* and 0.25 ns at 10 GHz -- well inside the 5 ns start-up window -- with the
* supplied outp/outn hint, with the opposite hint, with a balanced hint, and
* with no hint at all.

RLMN vdd qmn 3038

XMCL qml clkn tm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=28 nf=28
XMTL tm iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=32 nf=32

RLSP vdd outp 3100
RLSN vdd outn 3100
* sampling pair, driven straight from the master outputs
XSSP outn qmp qss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XSSN outp qmn qss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2

taskTitle: Design a static CML divide-by-2 frequency divider
circuit:
* Sky130 static CML divide-by-2 frequency divider (1 GHz .. 10 GHz).
*
* Topology
* --------
* Two identical current-mode-logic latches are wired as a master-slave loop
* with the slave outputs fed back to the master data inputs crossed over, i.e.
* a toggle flip-flop.  Being a static (fully regenerative) latch pair, the
* loop divides by two from DC up to its maximum toggle rate; nothing here
* relies on self-oscillation or on an injection-locked resonance, so the same
* sizing covers 1, 2, 5 and 10 GHz.
*
* Each latch is a classic four-transistor CML latch: a tracking pair that
* samples the data while its clock phase is high, a cross-coupled pair that
* regenerates and holds while the opposite phase is high, ideal resistor loads
* and an NMOS tail current source mirrored from the external 150 uA reference.
*
* Bias / headroom
* ---------------
* The clock common mode is fixed at 0.9 V, which is only ~0.2 V above the
* regular nfet threshold, so the steering pair would either starve or leave no
* drain-source headroom for the tail current source.  The steering pair
* therefore uses the low-Vt flavour (sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt) and is made
* wide (35 um) so it runs at a low current density: its gate overdrive is then
* small enough that the +-150 mV differential clock steers the tail current
* nearly completely, and the tail node still sits at ~0.25 V, which keeps the
* 28 um tail device (vdsat ~ 0.17 V) saturated.
*
* Sizing
* ------
* The tail devices mirror 2x the 150 uA reference (28 um / 14 um at l = 0.5),
* giving ~270 uA per latch.  Quiescent supply current is therefore
* 150 uA + 2 x 270 uA ~ 690 uA, i.e. ~1.26 mW at 1.8 V over all five corners,
* comfortably below the 1.5 mW budget.  Ideal load resistors of 2 kohm set a
* single-ended swing of I*R ~ 0.54 V (well over 1 Vpp differential at low
* frequency, ~0.42 Vpp still at 10 GHz where the loop runs closest to its
* limit), and because both the reference current and the load resistors are
* process independent the swing hardly moves across tt/ff/ss/fs/sf.
*
* The tracking and cross-coupled pairs are deliberately small (4 um): the
* output nodes already carry the 10 fF external load, so extra device
* capacitance there costs more toggle rate than the extra gm buys in loop
* gain.  The load resistance was then raised until the 10 GHz swing was
* comfortable without pushing the clock-to-output delay so late that the
* once-per-input-period output sample falls on an output transition edge.
*
* All transistors are built from nf=1 unit devices replicated with the integer
* multiplier m so that the total width and the per-finger width always select
* the same model bin.

*----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* One CML latch.
*   vb   : tail current mirror gate bias
*   clkt : clock phase that makes the latch transparent (tracking)
*   clkl : clock phase that makes the latch hold (regenerating)
*   dp/dn: differential data input
*   qp/qn: differential data output (inverted with respect to dp/dn)
*----------------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt cml_latch vss vdd vb clkt clkl dp dn qp qn
RLP vdd qp 2000
RLN vdd qn 2000
* Tracking pair.
XMDP qn dp st vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=1
XMDN qp dn st vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=1
* Cross-coupled regenerative pair.
XMLP qn qp sl vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=1
XMLN qp qn sl vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1 m=1
* Clock steering pair (low-Vt: the 0.9 V clock common mode leaves little
* overdrive, and this pair must also leave headroom for the tail source).
XMCT st clkt tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=5
XMCL sl clkl tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=7 nf=1 m=5
* Tail current source, 2x the external reference.
XMTAIL tail vb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=7 nf=1 m=4
.ends cml_latch

*----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Divide-by-two: master-slave toggle loop.
*----------------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt cml_div2 vss iref vdd clkn clkp outn outp
* Diode-connected mirror reference; sinks the external 150 uA into vss and
* biases both latch tail sources.
XMREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=7 nf=1 m=2
* Master latch: transparent while clkp is high, holds while clkn is high.
* Its data input is the slave output crossed over, which closes the toggle
* loop (outn -> dp, outp -> dn).
XLM vss vdd iref clkp clkn outn outp mp mn cml_latch
* Slave latch: transparent while clkn is high, holds while clkp is high.
XLS vss vdd iref clkn clkp mp mn outp outn cml_latch
.ends cml_div2

taskTitle: Design a static CML divide-by-2 frequency divider
circuit:
* Sky130 1.8 V static CML divide-by-2 frequency divider.
*
* Two current-mode-logic latches (master / slave) form a ring with one polarity
* inversion in the feedback path, so the ring toggles once per input clock
* cycle -> f_out = f_in / 2.  Each latch has an NMOS clock steering pair, an
* NMOS sampling pair, a cross-coupled NMOS regenerative pair (static hold, so
* the state is kept indefinitely at any clock rate) and two resistive loads to
* vdd.  Both tail currents are mirrored from the external 150 uA `iref`.
*
* The 0.9 V clock common mode at the pins is too low to stack a saturated tail
* current source under the clock pair (the nfet threshold is ~0.75 V once the
* body effect of the stacked pairs is included), so the clock is capacitively
* coupled into the core and re-biased to a higher internal common mode by a
* resistive divider.  That leaves ~0.5 V across the tail device and keeps the
* mirror ratio accurate over process.
*
.subckt cml_div2 vss iref vdd clkn clkp outn outp

* ---------------------------------------------------------------- parameters
* load resistors set both the output swing (i*rl) and the regeneration gain
.param rlm=1400
.param rls=1400
* output isolation keeps the 10 fF pin load off the regenerating slave nodes
.param riso=200
* Deliberate small load asymmetry.  A perfectly symmetric netlist has an exact
* balanced solution that a noiseless simulator never leaves, so each latch is
* given a ~1.5 % load imbalance (well inside real poly-resistor matching).  It
* seeds the regenerative pairs with a few mV of offset at start-up; the ring
* then toggles from the first clock edges regardless of which phase the
* released operating-point hint favours.
.param rmis=1.015
* switching device widths
.param wck=10
.param wdm=8
.param wlm=8
.param wds=8
.param wls=8
.param lsw=0.15
* tail mirror: wdio carries iref, each tail mirrors wtail/wdio
.param wdio=10
.param wtail=18
.param ltail=0.5
* internal clock common-mode bias and ac coupling
.param rdiv_top=80e3
.param rdiv_bot=280e3
.param rgate=4.5e3
.param ccpl=300e-15

* --------------------------------------------------------------- bias mirror
XMBD iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={ltail} w={wdio}  nf=5
XMT1 tl1  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={ltail} w={wtail} nf=9
XMT2 tl2  iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={ltail} w={wtail} nf=9

* ------------------------------------------------- internal clock level shift
RBT vdd vbc {rdiv_top}
RBB vbc vss {rdiv_bot}
CBD vbc vss 200e-15
RGP vbc ckp {rgate}
RGN vbc ckn {rgate}
CCP clkp ckp {ccpl}
CCN clkn ckn {ccpl}

* ------------------------------------------------------ master latch (mp/mn)
* transparent while ckp is high, holds while ckn is high
XMCK1 msmp ckp tl1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l={lsw} w={wck} nf=5
XMCK2 mhld ckn tl1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l={lsw} w={wck} nf=5
* sampling pair; D input is the inverted slave output
XMD1 mn son msmp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l={lsw} w={wdm} nf=4
XMD2 mp sop msmp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l={lsw} w={wdm} nf=4
* regenerative pair
XML1 mn mp mhld vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l={lsw} w={wlm} nf=4
XML2 mp mn mhld vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l={lsw} w={wlm} nf=4
RMP vdd mp {rlm*rmis}
RMN vdd mn {rlm}

* ----------------------------------------------------- slave latch (sop/son)
* transparent while ckn is high, holds while ckp is high
XSCK1 ssmp ckn tl2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l={lsw} w={wck} nf=5
XSCK2 shld ckp tl2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l={lsw} w={wck} nf=5
* sampling pair; D input is the master output
XSD1 son mp ssmp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l={lsw} w={wds} nf=4
XSD2 sop mn ssmp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l={lsw} w={wds} nf=4
* regenerative pair
XSL1 son sop shld vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l={lsw} w={wls} nf=4
XSL2 sop son shld vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l={lsw} w={wls} nf=4
RSP vdd sop {rls}
RSN vdd son {rls*rmis}

* output pins are tapped through small series resistors
RISOP sop outp {riso}
RISON son outn {riso}

.ends cml_div2

circuit:
* Static CML divide-by-2 frequency divider (Sky130 1.8V process).
* Architecture: master-slave CML D-flip-flop (two inverting CML latches)
* wired as a toggle, clocked by a differential CML steering pair. Bias is a
* 1:N current mirror of the external 150 uA reference current.
*
* Headroom note: the clock common-mode is fixed at 0.9 V, so the clock
* steering pair + tail current source stack must saturate with ns ~0.2-0.3 V.
* That forces low-Vth (LVT) devices with low overdrive (wide, L=0.15); a
* tall-Vov tail would collapse into triode and the latch would sit metastable.
*
* Latch is inverting (q = NOT d). Two inverting latches => non-inverting DFF.
* Toggle (D = Qb) needs slave.d = master.q (NOT master.qb); feeding slave.d
* from master.qb adds a third inversion and makes the loop latch instead of toggle.

.subckt cml_latch vdd vss ibias clksamp clkhold d db q qb
RLP vdd q  {Rload}
RLB vdd qb {Rload}
XIN1 q  d  ns_s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w={Wlat} nf={Wlat}
XIN2 qb db ns_s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w={Wlat} nf={Wlat}
XHH1 q  qb ns_h vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w={Wlat} nf={Wlat}
XHH2 qb q  ns_h vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w={Wlat} nf={Wlat}
XCKS ns_s clksamp ns vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w={Wclk} nf={Wclk/2}
XCKH ns_h clkhold  ns vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w={Wclk} nf={Wclk/2}
XTAIL ns ibias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w={Mt} nf={Mt/2}
.ends cml_latch

.subckt cml_div2 vss iref vdd clkn clkp outn outp
* Diode mirror of the external 150 uA reference; tail is Mrat x the reference.
XREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w={Mref} nf={Mref}
* Master samples on clkp (clk high), holds on clkn.
* Slave  samples on clkn (clk low),  holds on clkp.
* Toggle feedback: master d = slave qb (outn), master db = slave q (outp).
*                  slave  d = master q (qm),   slave db = master qb (qbm).

taskTitle: Design a static CML divide-by-2 frequency divider
circuit:
* Sky130 static CML divide-by-2 frequency divider.
* Two CML D-latches in master/slave toggle configuration.
* External iref (150 uA) programs a 1:1 NMOS current mirror that biases each
* latch tail. Resistor loads give a well-defined CML output swing.
* Device l/w are in microns (library sets scale=1u); no u suffix.
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Static CML D-latch.
*   clke/clkhold : differential clock (steers tail between eval/hold pair)
*   d/db         : differential data input
*   q/qb         : differential output (q = NOT d during evaluation)
*   vbias        : tail-current-mirror gate bias
* Stack: vdd - Rload - out - {eval|hold} pair - clock pair - tail CS - vss
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt cml_latch vss vdd clke clkhold d db q qb vbias
RLp  q  vdd 2.2k
RLn  qb vdd 2.2k
* evaluation (sense) input pair: drives output from d/db
XMe1 q  d  eval  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=3
XMe2 qb db eval  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=3
* regenerative cross-coupled hold pair (gm*Rload > 1 for solid latching)
XMh1 q  qb hold  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=3
XMh2 qb q  hold  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=3
* clock steering pair (wide: low Vov -> tail rises -> off-clock fully off)
XMce eval clke   tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=30 nf=15
XMch hold clkhold tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=30 nf=15
* tail current source (mirrored from iref; low Vdsat to stay saturated)
XMt  tail vbias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=20
.ends cml_latch

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Top-level divide-by-2: master/slave toggle flop.
*   master evaluates on clkp high (holds on clkn high)
*   slave  evaluates on clkn high (holds on clkp high)
*   feedback: D_master = Qb_slave, D_slave = Q_master  -> toggles each period
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt cml_div2 vss iref vdd clkn clkp outn outp
* diode-connected reference NMOS: iref current sets the gate bias node.
XMref iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=20
* master: d=Qb_slave(outn) db=Q_slave(outp) ; outputs qm,qbm
Xm vss vdd clkp clkn outn outp qm qbm iref cml_latch
* slave : d=qm db=qbm ; outputs outp,outn
Xs vss vdd clkn clkp qm qbm outp outn iref cml_latch
.ends cml_div2

taskTitle: Design a static CML divide-by-2 frequency divider
circuit:
* Static CML divide-by-2 frequency divider
* Master-slave topology with parallel data/clock steering per latch
* Clock steers tail current between data pair and cross-coupled pair
*
* Design rationale:
* - 2:1 mirror ratio: 300uA tail per latch (900uA total, 1.62mW)
* - 750 ohm loads: 225mV output swing (>200mV requirement)
* - 2:1 data sizing: stage_gain=0.47, latch_gain=2.4, loop_gain=1.12
* - Parallel topology avoids 3-NMOS stacking headroom problem
*
* Clock steering: Vgs_clk_high=0.515V, Vgs_clk_low=0.365V (both > Vth=0.25V)
* -> steering ratio ~2:1 (70% data / 30% latch when CLK high)
* -> Cross-coupled pair amplifies data perturbation via positive feedback
.subckt cml_div2 vss iref vdd clkn clkp outn outp

* Current mirror: 2:1 ratio (mirror=2x ref)
* Reference (small, nf=1) carries 150uA, each latch mirror (large, nf=2) carries 300uA
XMN_ref iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMN_tail_m tail_m iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
XMN_tail_s tail_s iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2

* === Master Latch ===
* Resistive loads: 750 ohm
RM_p outm_p vdd 750
RM_n outm_n vdd 750

* Data differential pair (2:1 sizing vs cross-coupled)
* Gates: slave output (inverted feedback for divide-by-2)
XMd1_m outm_p outn src_md vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
XMd2_m outm_n outp src_md vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
* Clock steering for data path (active when CLKP high)
XMck_md src_md clkp tail_m vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1

* Cross-coupled pair (positive feedback, minimum size)
XMl1_m outm_p outm_n src_mc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMl2_m outm_n outm_p src_mc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
* Clock steering for latch path (active when CLKN high)
XMck_mc src_mc clkn tail_m vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1

* === Slave Latch ===
* Resistive loads: 750 ohm
RS_p outp vdd 750
RS_n outn vdd 750

* Data differential pair (2:1 sizing)
* Gates: master output (direct feedback)
XMd1_s outp outm_p src_sd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
XMd2_s outn outm_n src_sd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
* Clock steering for data path (active when CLKN high)
XMck_sd src_sd clkn tail_s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1

* Cross-coupled pair (positive feedback, minimum size)
XMl1_s outp outn src_sc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMl2_s outn outp src_sc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
* Clock steering for latch path (active when CLKP high)
XMck_sc src_sc clkp tail_s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1

taskTitle: Design a static CML divide-by-2 frequency divider
circuit:
* Sky130 1.8 V static CML divide-by-2 frequency divider.
*
* Differential CML master/slave toggle flip-flop.
* Each CML latch: NMOS input differential pair with resistor loads to vdd,
*   cross-coupled PMOS regeneration, and a differential clock pair that
*   steers the tail current either to the input pair (transparent) or to a
*   dummy branch (hold).  Tail current is mirrored from the external 150 uA
*   reference on iref.
* The slave outputs are fed back crossed to the master inputs, so the
*   outputs toggle once per input cycle -> divide by 2.  The slave captures
*   on each rising edge of clkp, so the output is stable for most of the
*   cycle.
*
* Element policy: sky130 MOS wrappers + ideal resistors only.
*
.subckt cml_div2 vss iref vdd clkn clkp outn outp
*---------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias reference: the diode-connected device on iref (exactly 150 uA)
* sets the gate bias for the tail current mirrors.
*---------------------------------------------------------------
XREF iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
*---------------------------------------------------------------
* Master CML latch (transparent while clkp is high).
* qm_p/qm_n : internal differential outputs
* sm        : input-pair source node
* tm        : tail node
* pm        : dummy-branch node (steered away from sm during hold)
*---------------------------------------------------------------
XMA1 qm_p outn sm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
XMA2 qm_n outp sm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=30 nf=1
XMCKMP sm clkp tm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
XMCKMN pm clkn tm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
XMT6 tm iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
RMP qm_p vdd 8k
RMN qm_n vdd 8k
RDUM pm vdd 8k
XMMP qm_p qm_n vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=30 nf=1
XMMN qm_n qm_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=30 nf=1
*---------------------------------------------------------------
* Slave CML latch: outputs outp/outn. Transparent while clkn is high
* (clkp low), so it captures the master on each rising edge of clkp.
*---------------------------------------------------------------
XSA1 outp qm_p ss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
XSA2 outn qm_n ss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=30 nf=1
XSCKSP ss clkp ts vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
XSCKSN ps clkn ts vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
XST6 ts iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
RSP outp vdd 8k
RSN outn vdd 8k
RDSUM ps vdd 8k
XMSP outp outn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=30 nf=1
XMSN outn outp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=30 nf=1
.ends cml_div2
